name: The Lounge at Island Sound / The Velvet Monkey Speakeasy
description: The Lounge at Island Sound offers an intimate karaoke experience set in a cozy, stylish venue that combines a recording studio ambiance with a lively performance space. Guests enjoy high-quality sound, a carefully curated song library, and a welcoming atmosphere. The venue features both open performances and private rooms, making it ideal for private parties, special events, or casual nights out. Excellent food, drinks, and a friendly staff enhance the experience, which is available during scheduled events with reservations recommended.
